faqs.question: What documents do I need for my visa?
faqs.answer: You will need your passport, signed employment contract, proof of qualifications, and passport-sized photos. Specific requirements vary by destination country.

faqs.question: How do I update my housing preference?
faqs.answer: Go to Tasks > Benefit Elections > Housing section. You can switch between company accommodation and housing allowance at any time before your move date.

faqs.question: When will my work permit be ready?
faqs.answer: Work permit processing typically takes 4-8 weeks depending on the destination country. You can track the status in Services > Status > Immigration.

faqs.question: Can I change my travel dates?
faqs.answer: Yes, travel dates can be adjusted up to 2 weeks before departure. Go to Tasks > Update Calendar to modify your dates.

faqs.question: How does split pay work?
faqs.answer: Split pay divides your salary between your home and host country bank accounts. You can choose the ratio in Tasks > Benefit Elections > Split Pay.

faqs.question: Who handles my tax filing?
faqs.answer: Your assigned tax consultant will handle both home and host country tax filings. Check Services > Status > Tax for details and timelines.
